title: Typography
intro: Roboto across all digital products. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not color.

family.title: Typeface
family.description: Roboto (400, 500, 600, 700), loaded with next/font. Roboto Mono for code and technical values.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Sizes used in the HCP and admin screens.

guidelines.do1: Use the green eyebrow above the title to indicate the current section.
guidelines.do2: Keep body text at 14 px, and at least 16 px in form fields on mobile.
guidelines.do3: Use negative letter-spacing only on large headings.
guidelines.dont1: Don't use more than three different sizes in the same card.
guidelines.dont2: Don't write whole paragraphs in uppercase.
guidelines.dont3: Don't use weight 300 or lighter — it loses legibility on small screens.
